definitions.explanation: The final days of a month, typically the last few days.

examples.japanese: {月末|げつまつ}までに{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit it by the end of the month.

examples.japanese: {月末|げつまつ}はいつも{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: The end of the month is always busy.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{月末|げつまつ}{払|ばら}いです。
examples.english: Salary is paid at the end of the month.

notes:
{月末|げつまつ} specifically refers to the end of the month.

Related time expressions:
- {月初|げっしょ} (beginning of the month)
- {月半|つきなか}ば (middle of the month)
- {月末|げつまつ} (end of the month)

Common collocations:
- {月末|げつまつ}までに (by the end of the month)
- {月末|げつまつ}{払|ばら}い (end-of-month payment)
- {月末|げつまつ}{処理|しょり} (end-of-month processing)
- {月末|げつまつ}{締|し}め (closing at month-end)

Business context:
- Many deadlines and payments are set at {月末|げつまつ}
- {月末|げつまつ}{決算|けっさん} (month-end closing)
